summary: Focused frontend regression retest of the six iteration_1 fixes plus the authenticated core loop on https://ai-teacher-38.preview.emergentagent.com. ALL SIX FIXES VERIFIED PASS. (1) /demo: clicking next-button on SLIDE 1/4 now opens checkpoint-modal instead of skipping; all 4 seed segments gated the same way; MCQ answer -> evaluation-result. Confirmed the same gating on an authenticated real lesson (checkpoint opened on next-button click). (2) End-of-lesson auto-route: demo reached demo-complete with score (2/4 = 50%) with no Finish press; real lesson auto-routed from last segment to /assessment/sess_6b9eba6ea5b4 without pressing Finish. (3) Zero console errors on demo and real player - no '<ellipse> attribute ry' errors at all (only a pre-existing unauth 401 for /api/auth/me on the public /demo). (4) Mermaid: seed 'What is a Force?' img 131px tall inside 165px card; all 3 generated-lesson diagrams clamped to exactly ~300px and fully contained in [data-testid=mermaid-diagram]; nodes readable on dark theme after style sanitization. (5) report-next-button label 'Learn Basic Kinematics' (no mid-word cut; slice+ellipsis logic present for >22 chars) and clicking it navigates to /new with topic-input prefilled 'Basic Kinematics'. (6) /admin: gemini/groq/openrouter show '(No Key)' + neutral 'not configured' disabled toggles; emergent shows 'healthy' and toggles to 'forced fail' and back (simulate-failure reset verified via /api/admin/llm-status simulated_fail=false). REGRESSION core loop OK: /new topic Newton's Laws + time-5 -> LLM plan (~40s) -> player (3 segments) -> wrong short-answer produced 'Not quite' + misconception-note + adaptation-block (analogy) + follow-up question -> auto-route to assessment (4 LLM questions) -> submit -> report-view with report-score 0% (deliberately wrong answers), strong/weak areas and recommendation.

issues: Narration/caption bridges to an unrelated prior topic ('While the photosynthesis reaction needs specific inputs like CO2 and light...') on a physics lesson - profile-driven analogy reads as off-topic; content-quality nit only, not a defect

critical_code_review_comments: LessonPlayer.goToNext correctly gates unanswered checkpoints and calls onComplete on the last segment - fix is sound; note the narrationDone effect and goToNext both route to onComplete, so onComplete must stay idempotent (Player/DemoPlayer currently guard via state, keep it that way).
Avatar.js keyframe times normalized to [0,0.94,0.97,1] - ry error gone.
Mermaid.js sanitize() strips style/classDef/class/linkStyle lines and clamps the data-URI to max-h-[300px] object-contain - overflow resolved.
Backend nit carried over from iteration_1 (not retested): POST /api/admin/simulate-failure has replace-only semantics and silently ignores a `fail` field.
